notes.title: Fourth Update Available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042370/1ecc70f15511af8fbae43173d15605b42c5d20a7.png[/img]

Another Chicken Rider update is stores right now! This time besides further performance improvements we’ve added a new cool intro, new chicken and a new power-up! Check it right now!

notes.title: Third Update Available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042370/c4bbce7bfe072db62c74fd5f9bf4d4437089c229.png[/img]

New Chicken Rider update is already in the stores. This time besides further performance improvements we’ve added hints. Now after collecting a power-up, you will see it’s description. Right now we are working on another this time bigger update so stay tuned! Have fun and run!

notes.title: Second Update Available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042370/35cc5a6f2a9bde3327f598f7e6bf31084a086fd1.png[/img]

New Chicken Rider update is here! 

This update not only contains huge performance boost but also have:
[list]
[*]one new chicken, 
[*]one completely new level (along with new enemy), 
[*]new power-up, 
[*]and new upgrades!
[/list]
Go ahead and play it! As always we want to thank you for every review and comment.

notes.title: New Update Available!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042370/32b9359f4ceb219ee6b9f4620c6e67ed4d5cf3ea.png[/img]

We promised you a quick update, right? The latest version of Chicken Rider is now available on all platforms. Play the game, tell your friends, share the results, and just have fun. Meanwhile, we are working on another, this time a much bigger, update.

Patch notes:
[list]
[*]Changed prices in the shop, 
[*]Added powerup: rocket, 
[*]Added powerup: resurrection, 
[*]The current record is now always visible, 
[*]The helmet protects from rockets, 
[*]Added Instant Restore Pack after death
[/list]

notes.title: First Update Incoming
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33042370/339a6b8e556ebc729542f672da9232bce629a509.png[/img]
Hi all!
First of all, we want to thank you for playing Chicken Rider! It means a world for us. But the most important thing for our studio is your satisfaction. We want to assure you that we are reading all of your comments and reviews and we plan to improve Chicken Rider in the upcoming weeks. The first update will be out very soon.
